summary: Completed frontend testing of Prime Video page premium improvements. All requested features are working correctly including main player with fallback, hero section, compact grid, interactive buttons, and local favorites/history sections.

minor_warnings.issue: React prop warning for fetchPriority (should be lowercase fetchpriority)

passed_tests: ✅ Page loads without crash on desktop (1920x1080)
✅ Page loads without crash on mobile (390x844)
✅ Main Prime Video player visible with proper fallback when YouTube unavailable
✅ Fallback visual shows backdrop image with 'LECTURE DE SECOURS' badge and helpful message
✅ No raw error blocks breaking UI
✅ Hero Prime section present with selected anime (Death Note)
✅ Hero section displays title, description, badges, and smart badges
✅ Hero CTAs visible and functional: 'À regarder ce soir' button, 'Ouvrir Prime' external link
✅ 'À regarder ce soir' button toggles correctly (adds/removes from favorites)
✅ Similar anime suggestions strip visible in hero section
✅ Compact Prime anime grid present with 790+ cards
✅ Anime cards display with reduced size, titles, badges, and buttons
✅ Card Hero button interactive - updates hero section and scrolls to top
✅ Card Watch Tonight button interactive - adds to favorites
✅ 'Reprendre plus tard' (Resume Later) section visible and functional
✅ 'À regarder ce soir' (Watch Tonight) section appears after adding items
✅ Search filter functional (tested with 'naruto')
✅ Genre filter functional (tested with 'Action' - 400 results)
✅ Mood filter functional (tested with 'action' - 130 results)
✅ Player controls visible: mute toggle, cinema/vertical orientation, autoplay, next button
✅ Responsive layout works on mobile viewport
✅ All sections stable and no crashes during interaction
✅ Hover preview component integrated (HoverPreview.tsx)
✅ YouTube embed with fallback mechanism working (YouTubeEmbed.tsx)

notes.youtube_fallback: YouTube trailer availability is variable as expected. Fallback visual mechanism working correctly - shows backdrop image with helpful message instead of breaking UI.
notes.anilist_cors: AniList GraphQL API shows CORS errors in headless browser testing, but app handles this gracefully by using cached localStorage data (PRIME_CACHE). 790+ anime cards loaded from cache.
notes.mocked_apis: Video cards rely on YouTube library imported site-side. Some Prime reading paths use visual fallback when YouTube unavailable (as documented in review request).
notes.console_warnings: Minor YouTube tracking/analytics request failures (ERR_ABORTED) are expected and don't affect functionality. React prop warning for fetchPriority fixed.
